code: grid <- expand.grid(a = c(0, 0.14, 0.39), b = c(0, 0.39))  make_scenario <- function(a, b) {   medsim_scenario(     name = sprintf("a=%.2f b=%.2f", a, b),     data_generator = function(n) {       X <- rnorm(n)       M <- a * X + rnorm(n)       Y <- b * M + rnorm(n)       data.frame(X = X, M = M, Y = Y)     },     params = list(a = a, b = b, indirect = a * b)   ) } grid_scenarios <- Map(make_scenario, grid$a, grid$b) length(grid_scenarios) #> [1] 6 sizes <- c(100, 200, 500) by_n <- lapply(sizes, function(size) {   config <- medsim_config("local", n_replications = 500, n = size)   medsim_run(sobel, grid_scenarios, config, compute_truth = truth) })  # Scenario names repeat across the runs, so tag each analysis with its n power_by_n <- do.call(rbind, Map(function(res, n) {   cbind(n = n, medsim_analyze_power(res)$by_scenario) }, by_n, sizes)) power_by_n[power_by_n$scenario == "a=0.14 b=0.39", c("n", "scenario", "power")] #>      n      scenario power #> 5  100 a=0.14 b=0.39 0.176 #> 11 200 a=0.14 b=0.39 0.460 #> 17 500 a=0.14 b=0.39 0.858 make_scenario_n <- function(a, b, size) {   medsim_scenario(     name = sprintf("a=%.2f b=%.2f n=%d", a, b, size),     data_generator = function(n) {   # runner's n deliberately ignored       X <- rnorm(size)       M <- a * X + rnorm(size)       Y <- b * M + rnorm(size)       data.frame(X = X, M = M, Y = Y)     },     params = list(a = a, b = b, n = size, indirect = a * b)   ) } nonnormal_generator <- function(n) {   X <- rnorm(n)   M <- 0.39 * X + medsim_rnonnormal(n, skew = 2, kurtosis = 7)   Y <- 0.39 * M + rnorm(n)   data.frame(X = X, M = M, Y = Y) } missing_generator <- function(n) {   X <- rnorm(n)   M <- 0.39 * X + rnorm(n)   Y <- 0.39 * M + rnorm(n)   medsim_amputate(data.frame(X = X, M = M, Y = Y),                   target = "M", mechanism = "MAR", prop = 0.3,                   predictors = "X") } set.seed(1) colMeans(is.na(missing_generator(200))) #>     X     M     Y #> 0.000 0.335 0.000

code: sobel <- function(data, params) {   fm <- summary(lm(M ~ X, data = data))$coefficients   fy <- summary(lm(Y ~ X + M, data = data))$coefficients   a  <- fm["X", "Estimate"]; sa <- fm["X", "Std. Error"]   b  <- fy["M", "Estimate"]; sb <- fy["M", "Std. Error"]   se <- sqrt(b^2 * sa^2 + a^2 * sb^2)   # first-order delta method    list(     indirect          = a * b,     indirect_se       = se,     indirect_ci_lower = a * b - 1.96 * se,     indirect_ci_upper = a * b + 1.96 * se,     indirect_p        = 2 * pnorm(-abs(a * b / se))   ) }

title: medsim: Simulation Infrastructure for Mediation Analysis
text: Simulate mediation missingness nonnormality, test indirect effect validated multiple-imputation inference: generators (medsim_rnonnormal(), medsim_amputate(), medsim_scenario_missing()) domain-agnostic reusable across studies; estimator adapters (medsim_method_mbco_mi(), medsim_method_mc_ci(), medsim_method_ipw()) return standard coverage/power contract (MBCO-MI adds branch diagnostics top; methods’ rows NA-padded).
code: # Nonnormal residuals (Fleishman power method) + MCAR/MAR/MNAR amputation x <- medsim_rnonnormal(500, skew = 1.5, kurtosis = 4) d <- medsim_amputate(my_data, target = "M", mechanism = "MAR", prop = 0.2)  # A missing-data scenario: X -> M -> Y (optional nonnormal residuals) -> amputation scn <- medsim_scenario_missing(   name = "MAR_M_skewed",   true_params = list(a = 0.4, b = 0.4, cp = 0.2),   mechanism = "MAR", prop = 0.2,   nonnormal = list(skew = 1.5, kurtosis = 4) )  # Headline estimator: D4-stacked MBCO via multiple imputation (mice). Reproduces # the mitml::testModels(method = "D4") statistic (and its p-value with # df = "chan_meng"); degrades to a complete-case MBCO chi-square test when # imputation is unavailable. results <- medsim_run(   method = medsim_method_mbco_mi(model = NULL, m = 20),   scenarios = list(scn),   config = medsim_config("local") )  medsim_summarize_branch_switch(results)  # share of replicates whose majority branch is a = 0  # ariv = "fixed" recomputes the D4 ARIV on the branch the STACKED constrained # fit selects, so imputations that disagree on the branch cannot deflate it. # Both p-values (indirect_p, indirect_p_fixed) and the branch-mixing # diagnostics (branch_mix, p_branch_a, stacked_branch, r4, r4_fixed) are # always emitted; the default ariv = "own" is the legacy Chan-Meng pooling. # df = "chan_meng" refers both p-values to the Chan & Meng (2022, eq. 2.15) # denominator df (as mitml does); the default df = "li" is the Li et al. (1991) # approximation. Neither option changes the data, imputations, or statistic. medsim_method_mbco_mi(model = NULL, m = 20, ariv = "fixed", df = "chan_meng")

code: library(medsim) library(medfit) library(probmed)  # Simulate P_med coverage pmed_method <- function(data, params) {   fit_m <- lm(M ~ X, data = data)   fit_y <- lm(Y ~ X + M, data = data)    med_data <- medfit::extract_mediation(     fit_m, model_y = fit_y,     treatment = "X", mediator = "M"   )    p_med <- probmed::pmed(med_data)    # Bootstrap CI: outer nonparametric bootstrap resamples the data; the   # statistic refits the models and returns the P_med plugin point estimate   # (a scalar), as bootstrap_mediation() requires.   boot <- medfit::bootstrap_mediation(     statistic_fn = function(d) {       md <- medfit::extract_mediation(         lm(M ~ X, data = d), model_y = lm(Y ~ X + M, data = d),         treatment = "X", mediator = "M"       )       probmed::pmed(md, method = "plugin")@estimate     },     method = "nonparametric",     data = data,     n_boot = 1000   )    list(     estimate = p_med@estimate,     ci_lower = boot@ci_lower,     ci_upper = boot@ci_upper,     truth = params$true_pmed   ) }  results <- medsim_run(pmed_method, scenarios, config) coverage <- medsim_analyze_coverage(results)

title: Declare the estimand kind for a simulation scenario — medsim_estimand
text: Attach first-class estimand descriptor medsim_scenario().  Every downstream command (medsim_run, medsim_analyze_coverage, medsim_tables, medsim_figures, medsim_workflow) dispatches estimand$kind rather assuming scalar point-estimand. Five kinds recognised: "variance_share" bounded scalar point estimand standard Wald CI — Sobol / functional-ANOVA proportion mediated \(P_{med}^{\sigma^2} = V_{med}/V_T \[0,1]\) (see medsim_scenario_sobol(), medsim_method_sobol()).  Coverage uses generic truth CI path; dedicated kind exists clear labeling medsim_validate_scenario() checks causal-notation /M/Y/C columns Sobol estimator requires (rather legacy X/M/Y "point"). Scenarios estimand = NULL (default medsim_scenario()) treated kind = "point" throughout package – full back-compatibility existing code.

Defaults character() (auto-inferred downstream). truth Optional truth-extractor function(scenario) returning named numeric vector keyed names params.  Required kind = "interval" (bounds truth differs estimand ). ci CI method: "standard" (Wald/bootstrap), "imbens_manski" (partial-ID dual CI), "mbco" (constrained optimisation), "none". extra Character vector additional result columns beyond params method() returns – e.g. c("feasible", "branch_switch", "timing").

title: Create a Sobol / functional-ANOVA variance-share simulation scenario — medsim_scenario_sobol
text: Thin wrapper medsim_scenario() bakes : linear-Gaussian--interaction data generator -> M -> Y causal chain single covariate C *M interaction term (kappa). estimand = medsim_estimand("variance_share", params = "pmed_sobol", ci = "standard") descriptor, medsim_analyze_coverage() uses generic Wald truth %% CI path medsim_validate_scenario() checks /M/Y/C columns Sobol estimator requires. closed-form truth Sobol share, exact linear-Gaussian--interaction DGP (Monte-Carlo PO draw needed). estimand variance-scale proportion mediated \(P_{med}^{\sigma^2} = V_{med}/V_T\), functional-ANOVA variance components built four corner means \(\theta_{,'} = E[Y(, M('))]\).  linear-Gaussian DGP centered C, $$\theta_{,'} = \tau_a + (\tau_m + \kappa )\,\beta_a '.$$ kappa = 0 share reduces \(NIE^2/(NIE^2 + NDE^2)\) \(NIE = \tau_m \beta_a\) \(NDE = \tau_a\).

title: medsim 0.4.0
text: Critical: medsim_run_chunk() produced correlated, non-independent replications across SLURM array chunks. chunk_config$rep_offset computed never consumed, every chunk called set.seed(config$seed) scalar – every chunk regenerated identical short sequence “replications”, collapsing e.g. 1000-replication/60-chunk study ~17 truly distinct outcomes. Fixed seeding replication deterministically (scenario_name, global_rep_id) via new internal .medsim_det_seed(), independent chunk count, worker count, cluster type, execution order. config$seed/seed_stream longer affect medsim_run()/medsim_run_chunk() replication draws (remain meaningful direct medsim_run_parallel(seed = ...) call) – see updated docs medsim_config() medsim_run_parallel().
